$note: SUBJECT CONFIG (no coding needed). This file defines subject CARDS (name/icon/color) and, optionally, their CATEGORIES. It contains ZERO questions. Topics (JSON quiz files) are 100% auto-detected from folders: flat subjects read questions/<subject>/*.json; subjects with "categories" read questions/<subject>/<category-folder>/*.json. New subject folders are auto-detected even if not listed here.
$categories: OPTIONAL per subject. Add "categories" only where you want the 3-level hierarchy: Subject > Category > Topic > Quiz. Two forms are accepted: (a) a plain name string - the folder name is auto-generated from it ("Punjab GK" -> questions/gk/punjab-gk/, "Geography & Environment" -> questions/gk/geography-environment/); (b) an object { "name": "...", "folder": "...", "icon": "..." } when you want to control the folder name or icon yourself. Subjects without "categories" keep the original flat layout (questions/<subject>/*.json) and are unaffected. A category folder that exists on disk but is not listed here is auto-appended, so nothing ever gets hidden.
